tier_a.title: ACTS: Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering for Efficient and Controllable LLM Reasoning
tier_a.hook: Formulates CoT steering as MDP with a learned controller agent. Matches full-thinking accuracy with substantial token savings and controllable budget-accuracy trade-offs.

tier_b.title: PROVE: Programmatic Rewards On Verified Environments for Multi-Step Tool Use
tier_b.hook: RL training for multi-step tool use against 20 stateful MCP servers. Programmatic rewards replace judge models. +10.2 on BFCL Multi-Turn with only 13K examples.

tier_b.title: HybridThinker: CoT Compression via Compressed Memory and Transient Thought Steps
tier_b.hook: Dual-representation CoT compression: memory tokens + temporarily retained thought steps. Hybrid training prevents compression bypass. +5.8 avg accuracy over prior CoT compression.

tier_b.title: QUBRIC: Co-Designing Queries and Rubrics for RL Beyond Verifiable Rewards
tier_b.hook: Extends RL-based reasoning training to open-ended tasks by co-designing queries and rubrics. +5.5 ArenaHard, +6.3 avg on legal/moral/narrative transfer.

tier_c.title: Knowledge Editing in Masked Diffusion Language Models
tier_c.hook: Causal tracing transferred to masked diffusion LMs; multi-token edits fail due to unmasked intermediates.

tier_c.title: Expert-Aware Causal Tracing in Sparse MoE LMs
tier_c.hook: Identifies which routed experts mediate factual recall in MoE models.

tier_c.title: Consistency Training Can Entrench Misalignment
tier_c.hook: 7 consistency methods on 108 model organisms: suppresses reward hacking but amplifies sycophancy.

tier_c.title: Entropy Gate: Near-Lossless Token Compression
tier_c.hook: Thermodynamic-inspired token filtering: 40-60% compression at semantic fidelity > 0.80.

tier_c.title: Clustered Self-Assessment for LLM Uncertainty Quantification
tier_c.hook: Semantic clustering of samples into multiple-choice for confidence estimation. Works with 2 samples.

tier_c.title: EMBER: Robust Knowledge Erasure via Embedding Editing
tier_c.hook: Sparse matrix factorization on embeddings reduces relearning of erased knowledge by up to 50%.

tier_c.title: MLEvolve: Self-Evolving Automated ML Algorithm Discovery
tier_c.hook: LLM multi-agent framework with Progressive MCGS and Retrospective Memory for ML algorithm search.

tier_c.title: Hybrid Verified Decoding
tier_c.hook: Learned verification allocation for speculative decoding; 2.73x speedup on agentic workflows.

news.title: Microsoft released MAI-Thinking-1 and MAI-Code-1-Flash at Build 2026
news.summary: 35B-active-param reasoning model (no OpenAI data). MAI-Code-1-Flash 5B coding model for Copilot.

news.title: Google released Gemma 4 12B
news.summary: Encoder-free multimodal (text+image+audio+video), 256K context, runs on 16GB VRAM. Apache 2.0.

news.title: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8
news.summary: Dynamic workflows, Super-Agent benchmark leader. $5/$25 per 1M input/output tokens.

already_ported.description: Masked autoencoders from CV applied to paired PPG/ECG biosignals (featured yesterday).

unported.hypothesis: A controller trained to manage when a sensor-data agent should stop analyzing and commit to a classification could reduce inference cost for on-device clinical applications.

unported.technique: Programmatic rewards for tool-use RL with stateful environments
unported.hypothesis: Building stateful environments where tools are signal processing functions and state is an evolving clinical interpretation would enable RL training for biosignal analysis pipelines.
